fields.name: Sharding
fields.responsibility: Holds how ArgentSea spreads one logical dataset across many databases: the record identity that combines a shard with the record's own key and its external encodings, choosing which shards a query reaches and what each contributes, running a query across shards and combining the results, and addressing a single known shard directly. These belong together because each depends on the shard-qualified identity and the shard-set topology; it mirrors the Sharding section of the documentation.
